basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Project Research Scientist & Other Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Transplant Immunology and Immunogenetics, AIIMS, New Delhi, has invited applications for two temporary posts under the ICMR funded project (I-2052) on immune exhaustion in Indian primary immunodeficiency disorders. The project runs for 3 years. Pay is Rs. 67000 + 30% HRA monthly for Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) and Rs. 20000 + 30% HRA monthly for Project Technical Support - II. Send your curriculum vitae to [email protected] by 17 November 2026.

how_to_apply: The notice asks interested candidates to send their up-to-date curriculum vitae by email to [email protected]. The last date to send the curriculum vitae is 17 November 2026. The notice names no other document and prints no postal address, form or email subject line.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The two posts sit in the Department of Transplant Immunology and Immunogenetics at AIIMS, New Delhi. They are funded by ICMR under project I-2052, titled "Immune Exhaustion Signature in Indian Primary Immunodeficiency Disorders: Correlation with Clinical Severity and Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplant Outcomes". The notice calls the positions temporary and gives the duration as 3 years.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 1 post each, 2 posts in total. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives the minimum essential qualification and age limit for each post. It does not print the date for counting age. It also prints no age relaxation. The notice prints no desirable qualification. For the exact subject and experience requirements of each post, check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: First class Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, with three years' experience or PhD; OR Second Class Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG Degrees, with PhD and three years' experience

12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering) + Five Years' Experience in relevant subject/field Guidelines; OR Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + two years experience in relevant subject

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) is paid Rs. 67000 + 30% HRA monthly. Project Technical Support - II is paid Rs. 20000 + 30% HRA monthly. Both posts are temporary positions under a project with a duration of 3 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice asks interested candidates to send their up-to-date curriculum vitae by email to [email protected] . The last date to send the curriculum vitae is 17 November 2026. The notice names no other document and prints no postal address, form or email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. The notice gives no interview date, venue or shortlisting criteria.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: A first class Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees, with three years' experience or PhD. The other route is a Second Class Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG Degrees, with PhD and three years' experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support - II?
faq.answer: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering) + Five Years' Experience in relevant subject/field, or a Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + two years experience in relevant subject.

faq.answer: The limit is 35 years for Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) and 30 years for Project Technical Support - II.

faq.answer: Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) gets Rs. 67000 + 30% HRA monthly. Project Technical Support - II gets Rs. 20000 + 30% HRA monthly.

faq.answer: No. The notice describes them as temporary positions under an ICMR funded project with a duration of 3 years.
